description: Shared definitions for Open Music Performance records. STUBBORN_FACT: the NSID prefix org.openmusicperformance is a placeholder until the fiscal sponsor owns a domain; it is referenced only through the lexicon ids, so renaming is a search-and-replace across schemas/ (see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md Q1).

strongRef.description: A reference to a specific version of another record.

money.description: An amount in minor units of an ISO 4217 currency. 500 USD cents is $5.00.

location.description: A physical place. Address fields are optional so a house concert can withhold its street address until RSVP.

contact.description: An adult contact collected by the organizer. Never a student record (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md section 7).

marketingConsent.description: True only if the person opted in to be contacted about future events.

issuerKey.description: The public half of an organization's Ed25519 ticket-signing key.

kid.description: Key id carried in every signed ticket.

publicKeyMultibase.description: Multibase (base58btc, z-prefixed) encoding of the raw public key.
